collections.name: Foundation
collections.description: Combined collection with colors, semantic tokens, and borders. Must be together due to cross-references.
notes: Cannot be split - Figma requires references in same collection

collections.name: Layout
collections.description: Grid system: breakpoints, container widths, columns, and gutters.

collections.name: Spacing
collections.description: Spacing scale for margins, padding, and gaps (0-192px).

collections.name: Radius
collections.description: Border radius scale for rounded corners (0-20px).

collections.name: Shadows
collections.description: Shadow presets with component variables (offsetX/Y, blur, spread).
notes: Component variables use NUMBER type for Figma effects
Shadow offsets viewport-based, colors theme-based (in Foundation)

collections.name: Typography
collections.description: Font families, sizes, weights, line heights, and heading/display styles.
notes: Single font names for Figma (Inter, Roboto Mono)
Bootstrap RFS handles responsive scaling in CSS

collections.name: Components
collections.description: Component-specific tokens (buttons, cards, forms, etc.). Check each file for cross-references.
notes: Components may reference Foundation collection tokens
If components reference Foundation, they must be merged into Foundation collection
Or keep components as separate files if no cross-references needed
